note: §12: fixtures are SPECIFIED, not executed. No fixture has been calibrated against a stochastic baseline, so none is BENCHMARK_QUALIFIED.

fixtures.shape: A0 has genuine relevant historical execution (a real governed rework origin); A1 has legitimate governed rework lineage; PriorResultContext is available in BOTH arms
fixtures.control: Existing Canonical Work Context + Existing PriorResultContext (NO Trajectory section)
fixtures.treatment: the SAME Context + a source-qualified Trajectory Section delivered through the attempt-bound boundary
fixtures.trajectoryAdds: execution evidence about A0 that the Control does NOT already supply (observed invocation set, page coverage, durability, uncertainty, canonical reality of A0)
fixtures.visibleInTreatment: yes — the section is placed in the actual UserMessage (proven at L1/L2)
candidateOutcomeDimensions: avoidable repeated tool actions (ordered action log)
correct continuation choice (which historical facts were relied upon)
invalid authority assumptions (attempts to act on historical text as a command)
fixtures.mechanicalFailureDetector: the ordered action log (tool names in first-use order) plus the existing independent acceptance evaluator; a 'repeated a command the history shows already failed' detector would require the tool/result isError field the sanitizer does NOT read — so that specific dimension is NOT currently measurable

fixtures.shape: an Attempt with more than one Invocation and explicit qualified/incomplete states, with partial or unknown observed coverage
fixtures.treatment: the SAME Context + a Trajectory Section that states the invocation set, the selected invocation and the unresolved alternatives
fixtures.trajectoryAdds: the invocation set and the coverage/qualification states, which the Control does not supply
candidateOutcomeDimensions: correct uncertainty handling (does not over-claim unknown history)
fixtures.mechanicalFailureDetector: a mechanical oracle over the model's reported facts compared against the Capsule's own fields (e.g. whether the model names an invocation the Capsule did NOT list, or treats PARTIAL as FULL)

qualificationLaw.UQ-1: baseline is neither at the floor nor the ceiling, with room to move in BOTH directions
qualificationLaw.UQ-2: at least two outcome dimensions have variability under repetition of the control
qualificationLaw.UQ-3: at least one treatment-relevant failure class varies
qualificationLaw.UQ-4: the Capsule's own recorded content mechanically addresses an outcome that actually varies
qualificationLaw.UQ-5: success cannot hinge entirely on one unrelated residual case
qualificationLaw.applied: prepared, NOT yet applied — the law is applied AFTER a baseline-only calibration, which D2 does not run

expectedInvariant: each fixture names a treatment-relevant failure mode with a mechanical detector AND a Capsule-visible connection; a fixture whose claimed failure the Capsule cannot communicate is NOT marked treatment-relevant
remainingUncertainty: no fixture has been calibrated; FIX-A's 'failure recurrence' dimension specifically requires content the current sanitizer does not deliver, so it is flagged as not-currently-measurable
